title: SyntheticBill
description: A fictional hospital bill plus ground truth, produced by /synthetic for evals, tests, and demos. Contains no real people, hospitals, or prices. line_items is what a perfect extraction returns; expected_flags is what /core should produce for line_items and price_references.

bill_id.description: Stable id derived from scenario and seed, for example 'mixed-7'.

hospital_name.description: Fictional hospital name, clearly marked as fictional.

statement_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) printed on the statement.

total_billed.description: Sum of billed_amount over line_items, in US dollars.

price_references.description: Fictional reference prices (data_source 'synthetic-demo') used to build expected_flags.

quantity_limits.description: Fictional quantity limits (data_source 'synthetic-demo'). Pass to analyze(quantity_limits=...). Optional; older bills omit it.

bundle_pairs.description: Fictional bundle pairs (data_source 'synthetic-demo'). Pass to analyze(bundle_pairs=...). Optional; older bills omit it.

expected_flags.description: Exactly the (line_item_id, flag_type) pairs /core should return. Text fields are not part of ground truth.
